status.unsaved: Unsaved changes. Use Save Draft or Publish above.
status.unsync: Saved changes are not live yet. Publish to share them.
status.draft: Draft. Learners can't see this until you publish.

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.hint: Learners flip each card, then mark it Got it or Still learning. Cards they are still learning come back until they know them all.
flashcards.empty: Add at least one card with a front and a back before you publish.

poll.title: Poll
poll.question: Question
poll.questionPlaceholder: What would you like to ask the class?
poll.optionsHint: 2 to 8 choices. There is no right answer; learners see how the class voted.

errors.question: Write the question.
errors.duplicate: Two choices say the same thing.

game.title: Game
game.pagePlaceholder: Paste a complete HTML page here, or upload a file.
game.protocol: To save a score, the page posts:
game.noScore: This page never reports a result, so no score will be saved. Learners can still mark it complete.
game.tooBig: That file is over 2 MB. Use a smaller page.
game.maxScoreHint: Scores above this are capped. Leave empty if the page reports its own maximum.
game.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: Match each word to its meaning before the timer runs out.

results.publishFirst: Publish the poll to collect votes.
